title: How to fish slop (Astra couple prompts)
author: Important_Luck_3546

comments.author: Important_Luck_3546
comments.body: It's a shameless clone of the popular "How to fish" game. I wanted to test out the Astra 3D and Godot capabilities without having to come up with an original game. I think I'm impressed enough to probably make some Godot 3D project. Sol really struggled with the same prompts (pancake island, bad atmosphere color).

replies.author: Important_Luck_3546
replies.body:
I wasn't going to bother but Astra light got you covered (summarized prompts):

Sol xhigh:
- “Make a simple Godot FPS with Blender models: small rocky island, lighthouse keeper, sunny weather, flying birds, and a pistol to shoot them. Low-poly style, real bullet trajectories, 10-round magazines, reload animations, smooth movement.”
- “Fix backwards birds, NPC scale, sensitivity, recoil and muzzle flash. Improve bird flight, ocean and underwater death. Add rocky terrain, elevation, a proper pistol and aiming down sights.”
- “Make island elevation less uniform, put the lighthouse on high ground, improve jumping and collisions, extend the ocean to the horizon, fix the sun, birds and sight alignment.”
- “Smooth the terrain, make rocks gray, add bunny hopping, stronger recoil and proper reload animations. Make shorelines steep, remove loose rocks, fix the horizon, and let the keeper say hello with E.”
- “The island still looks like a pancake and cement. Add rounded granite hills and texture, fix shadows and duplicate suns, make the sky sunny and the ocean deep blue with reflections and gentle waves.”

Astra high starts here:
- “Look at the Sol thread and fix the game to match my original vision and follow-up feedback. Change models, code, behaviour and visuals as needed.”

Astra max before imminent reset to burn tokens:
- “Add inventory, fishing, money, physical shop upgrades, fish combat and blood, selling to the keeper, and a drivable boat. Build a fish → sell → upgrade loop. Add a boss lure, jumping boss attacks, damage and death. Use How to Fish as inspiration.”
- “Polish fishing: carry catches on the line and press E to drop. Make fish slide and flop toward water. Replace verbose instructions with NPC dialogue. Add nine inventory slots, punching, a purchasable gun, corpse pickups and selected-fish selling. Simplify reeling to a 90% catch chance. Make rocks less smooth and more pixelated.”
- “Make fish flop higher and more unpredictably, reel faster, and yank them out before they reach shore. Add an NPC explaining bait.”
